title: Project Hertz attempt2
description: What a fellow submits after finishing the conversation: the attempt2/ folder at the root of the task repository (its own pull request into main), one plain-text file per field plus meta.txt. The older attempt2.json with this exact shape is still accepted.

conversation_id.description: The identifier of the conversation you are submitting, copied from the platform.

first_message_changed.description: true if the first message you actually sent differs from attempt1.json.

change_reason.description: Required when first_message_changed is true: why you changed it.

first_message_used.description: The first message exactly as sent to the model.

finish_notes.description: What you wrote on Finish: how you checked the result, which files and commands a reviewer should look at; or what works, what does not, and why you stopped.

flags_count.description: Optional: how many responses you flagged.
